visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: In a changing country fresh from warfare, can a renowned swordsman truly defend the vulnerable using an inverted blade that forbids him to kill?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In 1868, following the close of the Bakumatsu war, former assassin Kenshin Himura roams Japan armed with a reversed-edge sword, committed to protecting people in need without taking another life.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Exciting and reflective samurai action, carrying swift martial energy and measured dramatic weight.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Keishi Otomo pairs dynamic period martial arts with the moral friction of an elite killer trying to navigate a new era through strict nonviolence.
